title: Short Urls
description: A Laravel URL shortener with configurable link expiry and a live dashboard that polls visit counts in real time, secured with Laravel Breeze authentication.

title: Bench Finder
description: A React and Mapbox GL app that locates nearby benches using OpenStreetMap data, showing live distances and directions from your current location with an adjustable search radius.

title: Purrfect Home
description: A 2D pixel art cat adoption game developed in Unity as my final year project, designed to promote cat adoption and fostering while offering a relaxing experience.

title: Run with Rexy App
description: A dinosaur-themed running app designed to motivate people to stay active, compatible with both iOS and Android, and showcased at the Bath Digital Festival.

title: Spatial Awareness
description: A Unity game where you play a janitor on an intergalactic space cruiser, keeping it running by completing as many maintenance tasks as possible before things fall apart.

title: CryptoTracker App
description: CryptoTracker fetches real-time cryptocurrency data via an API, displays market values, and features SwiftUI Charts for visualising trends.
